title: Ball Screws, Part 1: Vocabulary and Designation
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 3408 establishes the vocabulary for ball screws (see figure 1). NOTE — The actual design need not necessarily correspond to that shown in figure 1 . It also specifies the various elements which designate ball screws. Bail screw shaft Figure 1 —Ball screw

clause_2_normative_references.title: ISO Systems of limits and fits, Part 1: Bases of tolerance, deviations and fits

clause_3_terminology: Ball Screws, Part 1: Vocabulary and Designation

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
